landmarks.name: Chandni Chowk
landmarks.note: the bazaar street, running east-west with only 30 m clear between the shopfronts: at street level this is the only through route, and the pad is on the median outside the Town Hall

landmarks.name: the Lahori Gate
landmarks.note: the Red Fort's main gate, closing the east end of the street

landmarks.name: the Red Fort
landmarks.note: sandstone walls 20 m tall enclosing the ground east of the gate

landmarks.name: the Jama Masjid
landmarks.note: 330 m south of the street; the two minarets reach 41 m, well above every roof around them

landmarks.name: Dariba Kalan
landmarks.note: the jewellers' lane running north off the street

landmarks.name: Fatehpuri Masjid
landmarks.note: closes the west end of the street

landmarks.name: Khari Baoli
landmarks.note: the spice market, beyond Fatehpuri Masjid

landmarks.name: the Old Delhi railway station
landmarks.note: 300 m north, with a 30 m clock tower at its west end
